Package Common

Class ReportImage

java.lang.Object
Common.ReportImage
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ReportImage extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a generated report saved as an image file. This entity class encapsulates the report's metadata (such as its type, associated park, and date) along with the actual image data stored as a byte array. Implements Serializable to allow the transfer of report images over the network.

  • Constructor Details

    • ReportImage

      public ReportImage(String reportType, String parkName, int month, int year, byte[] image)
      Constructs a new ReportImage intended for saving to the database. This constructor omits the reportId and createdAt fields, as they are typically generated automatically by the database upon insertion.
      Parameters:
      reportType - The type of the report.
      parkName - The name of the park.
      month - The month the report covers.
      year - The year the report covers.
      image - The byte array containing the image data.

    • ReportImage

      public ReportImage(int reportId, String reportType, String parkName, int month, int year, String createdAt, byte[] image)
      Constructs a ReportImage with all fields populated. This constructor is typically used when fetching an existing report from the database.
      Parameters:
      reportId - The unique ID of the report.
      reportType - The type of the report.
      parkName - The name of the park.
      month - The month the report covers.
      year - The year the report covers.
      createdAt - The timestamp of when the report was created.
      image - The byte array containing the image data.
